verdict.rationale: Cake documents a 'flexible vesting engine' that automates cliffs, schedules, milestones and pauses. Vesting can be attached to founder shares at issuance, and the dashboard tracks upcoming vesting events and who vests next, so the core of automatic vested-vs-unvested tracking is evidenced. However, the evidence never mentions acceleration on exit (single or double trigger), which is an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: documented acceleration-on-exit support, detail on vested vs unvested balance reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically

citations.quote: Automate cliffs, schedules, milestones, and pauses without manual work.
You can attach a vesting schedule to ordinary or founder shares at the point of issuance
A count at the top tells you how many vesting events fall within the next 7 days.
it shows what needs your attention, who vests next
